description: This file defines the JoinTask class, a workflow activity for handling join operations in a workflow system, including modes for waiting on all or any inbound transitions, and managing inbound/outbound transitions and blocking activities.

classes.name: JoinTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for joining multiple workflow branches with modes for waiting on all or any inbound transitions.

methods.name: get_DisplayText
methods.description: Returns the localized display text for the activity.

methods.name: get_Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the activity.

methods.name: get_Mode
methods.description: Gets the current join mode (WaitAll or WaitAny).

methods.name: get_Branches
methods.description: Gets the list of branch identifiers.

methods.name: set_Branches
methods.description: Sets the list of branch identifiers.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the join activity logic based on inbound transitions and mode.

methods.name: OnActivityExecutedAsync
methods.description: Handles post-execution logic, updating inbound transition branches.

methods.name: GetTransitionKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a transition based on source activity and outcome.
